title: Generation of mouse bone marrow-derived dendritic cells \(BM-DCs)
protocol: Flush mouse tibiae and femurs with ice-cold PBS through a 70 μm-wide cut-off cell strainer.
Resuspend pelleted cells in conditioned medium supplemented with 10% of growth supernatant of GM-CSF-transduced B16 cells.
Seed 7 x 10^6 cells in 100 x 20 mm non-treated cell culture plates in 10 ml of conditioned medium.
On day 4 and 7, add 5 ml of pre-warmed conditioned medium.
At day 8/9, harvest the supernatant and gently wash the plate once with 5 ml of pre-warmed PBS.
Incubate 2' with 5 ml of 2mM EDTA at 37°C – 5% CO2.
Collect cells, wash once with PBS.
Resuspend pelleted cells in conditioned medium.
